fields.name: Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max (Cosmic Orange, 256 GB)
fields.description: Experience the pinnacle of smartphone innovation with the Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max in Cosmic Orange (256 GB). Powered by the groundbreaking A19 Pro Bionic chip, featuring a Super Retina XDR OLED display with 120Hz ProMotion, Aerospace-grade Titanium chassis, ceramic shield front, and an advanced 48MP Fusion Triple Camera system with 10x Optical Zoom.
fields.short_description: A19 Pro Chip, 6.9-inch Super Retina XDR, 48MP Triple Camera, Titanium Design, Cosmic Orange

fields.name: Ergonomic Mesh Office Chair
fields.description: High-back ergonomic chair with adjustable lumbar support, 3D armrests, and breathable mesh backrest for all-day comfort.
fields.short_description: High-back ergonomic chair with lumbar support.

fields.name: Air-Cushioned Running Shoes
fields.description: Breathable mesh running shoes with impact-absorbing air cushion soles for maximum comfort during long workouts.
fields.short_description: Breathable mesh running shoes with air cushion sole.

fields.name: Smartwatch Ultra 2 (AMOLED Display)
fields.description: Rugged titanium case, precision dual-frequency GPS, heart rate monitor, ECG app, and up to 36 hours of battery life.
fields.short_description: Rugged titanium smartwatch with heart rate & GPS.

fields.name: Wireless Noise-Canceling Headphones
fields.description: Industry leading active noise cancellation with dual noise sensor technology. Up to 30 hours battery life with quick charging.
fields.short_description: Active noise canceling wireless headphones with 30h battery.

fields.name: Flagship Smartphone 5G (256GB Storage)
fields.description: Pro-grade camera with 108MP main sensor, 120Hz AMOLED display, 5000mAh battery, and superfast 5G connectivity.

fields.name: Pro Ultra Laptop (16GB RAM, 512GB SSD)
fields.description: Ultra-thin high performance laptop with M2 chip, 16GB unified memory, and 512GB SSD storage. Retina display with True Tone technology.
fields.short_description: Ultra-thin high performance laptop with 16GB RAM & 512GB SSD.
